commands.command:
set -eu
git fetch origin work/ux-evolution
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/work/ux-evolution)"
echo 'WORKTREE_CANDIDATE';git status --short
pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile exec vitest run src/__tests__/hardware-setup.test.tsx --reporter=dot >/tmp/shelly-ionic-card-ble-178-focused.log 2>&1 || {
  echo 'FOCUSED_TEST_FAILED'
  grep -E 'FAIL|Error|×|Test Files|Tests ' /tmp/shelly-ionic-card-ble-178-focused.log | tail -65 || true
  tail -45 /tmp/shelly-ionic-card-ble-178-focused.log
  exit 33
}
grep -E 'Test Files|Tests ' /tmp/shelly-ionic-card-ble-178-focused.log | tail -5
pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile typecheck
git diff --check
git add apps/mobile/src/screens/hardware-setup/pages/ShellySetupPresentation.tsx apps/mobile/src/theme/theme.css apps/mobile/src/__tests__/hardware-setup.test.tsx
git commit -m "refactor(ionic): saved Shelly BLE card scan as compact Ionic action"
git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/work/ux-evolution
echo "MIGRATION_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
git status --short
